channel.title: Updates: Political Candidates’ Airline Credit [Records Request]
channel.description: Updates on the Data Liberation Project's Political Candidates’ Airline Credit request

item.title: Document Published
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On July 6, 2025, the Data Liberation Project published the document received from the Department of Transportation.

item.title: Document Provided
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On July 25, 2024, the Department of Transportation provided a 71-page PDF collating forms from various airlines. The DLP later confirmed with the agency that this was all the documentation it had available.

item.title: Request Acknowledged
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On April 25, 2024, the Department of Transportation emailed a letter 📄 acknowledging this request and assigning it tracking number OST-2024-0388.
